snippet.title: The Rocks Under You Are Asleep. Survive the Sperm Whales.
snippet.description:
You're snorkeling off Dominica. Grey towers are standing in the blue under you. They're not rocks.

Fact-checked. Sperm whales sleep upright, nose up, motionless, for about 10 to 15 minutes at a time (Miller et al. 2008, Current Biology). A resident population lives off Dominica all year (The Dominica Sperm Whale Project). Females reach 11 to 12 meters, and the species has the largest brain of any animal, about 8 kg.

Their clicks reach about 230 decibels under water, the loudest sound made by any animal (Møhl et al. 2003). Divers say they can feel them in their bodies at close range.

Orcas attack sperm whale groups for the calves. The adults form a rosette: heads in, tails out, calves in the middle (Pitman et al. 2001). On 19 March 2024, off Bremer Canyon, Western Australia, a pod in a rosette defecated and fanned the cloud at the orcas with their tails, and the orcas backed off (Live Science; ABC News Australia; marine biologist Jennah Tucker).

In Dominica you need a permit to get in the water with sperm whales. Watch from a licensed boat.

Music: "Frolic" (Luciano Michelini), short excerpt.

This is general information, not professional advice.

snippet.title: A los 63 dejé de cuidar a mis nietos… ¡y mi hijo me llamó egoísta! #reflexion #abuela #familia
snippet.description:
A los 63 dejé de cuidar a mis nietos y mi hijo me llamó egoísta. Descubre cómo establecer límites familiares saludables.

Cuidar a los nietos comenzó como un apoyo ocasional, pero pronto se convirtió en un compromiso de tiempo completo que consumió mi vida personal. En este relato, comparto mi experiencia al intentar recuperar mi independencia y la reacción negativa de mi hijo al percibir esta decisión como un acto de egoísmo. Enfrentar las expectativas de la familia a menudo nos obliga a cuestionar el rol de los abuelos en la crianza actual.

Aprender a poner límites claros es fundamental para evitar el agotamiento emocional y mantener una relación sana con nuestros hijos adultos. Esta historia es una lección sobre cómo priorizar nuestro bienestar personal y cerrar ciclos de dependencia, entendiendo que decir no es necesario para vivir con plenitud. Recuperar nuestra libertad después de años de sacrificio nos permite redescubrir nuestra propia identidad más allá de las exigencias ajenas.

Suscríbete para acompañarme en estas reflexiones y cuéntame en los comentarios: ¿alguna vez has tenido que defender tu tiempo personal frente a las exigencias de tu propia familia?

snippet.title: How to Build a B-17 Flying Fortress, One Problem at a Time
snippet.description:
The B-17 Flying Fortress was not a modified airliner. Boeing designed its four-engine Model 299 to answer a 1934 Army Air Corps call for a multi-engine bomber that could carry 2,000 pounds of bombs over long distances. The prototype first flew on July 28, 1935.
Douglas did turn an airliner into a bomber: its B-18 Bolo was based on the DC-2. Boeing's four-engine prototype carried its load higher, faster and nearly twice as far as its rivals, and when war came, the B-18 quickly proved inadequate for combat.
Flying low was dangerous. A 1943 U.S. War Department report rated German machine-gun fire effective to about 2,400 feet and 37 mm guns to about 5,000 feet.
GE turbosuperchargers helped the B-17's engines keep their power at high altitude. Eighth Air Force bombers attacked from an average altitude of about 21,000 feet, roughly four miles up, but heavy flak guns like the German 88 mm could still reach them.
Up there, crews faced temperatures of minus 40°F and colder; they needed oxygen masks and wore electrically heated suits.
The Norden bombsight was an analog computer that constantly calculated the bombs' trajectory and released them automatically. Even so, in 1943 the average circular error was about 1,200 feet.
German fighters attacked from many directions. The B-17 answered with powered top and ball turrets, tail guns and, on later models, a chin turret.
Turrets that could hit the bomber's own tail or propellers had a fire cutoff that stopped the guns automatically. A Sperry patent filed in 1943 describes a cam whose raised portions represent parts of the aircraft, such as the tail.
The B-17G carried up to 13 .50-caliber machine guns.
A lone bomber remained highly exposed, so bombers flew in staggered "combat box" formations with interlocking fields of fire. Still, unescorted bombers on deep raids paid a heavy price.
The name came from a reporter who saw the Model 299 in 1935 and called it a "flying fortress."
About the visuals: everything is simplified 3D animation. Building a B-17 step by step from an airliner is a storytelling device; the real parts were not added in this order. The opening airliner is modeled on the Boeing 247; one late B-17G model is used throughout. The crew members are generic 3D figures, not real people; the fighters are generic Bf 109s; and the fields stand in for European farmland. Real markings were removed. "BOOLEAN CUT" is the channel name.

snippet.title: O calote do agronegócio no Banco do Brasil e a chantagem contra Lula
snippet.description:
O jornalista Rodrigo Viana afirmou que o governo Lula 4 nem tomou posse e já enfrenta um ataque de dois lados: do sistema financeiro e do agronegócio. No caso do agro, a ferramenta é financeira: deixar de pagar o Banco do Brasil e derrubar as ações do banco para criar dificuldades ao governo, numa chantagem que não tem relação com o mundo real da agricultura, que vai muito bem.

A jornalista Mali provou que é chantagem: o agro exportou cento e trinta e três bilhões de dólares até setembro de 2026, ou seja, dinheiro não falta. Pannunzio reforçou que é muito dinheiro e lembrou que o governo financia toda a produção, enquanto eles faturaram, pegaram emprestado e enfiaram o dinheiro no bolso, mas não querem pagar. Já na agricultura familiar, tudo certo: inadimplência baixa, menos de 5%, e os pequenos produtores que botam comida na mesa estão em dia com o Banco do Brasil, produzindo quietos e sem reclamar.

🟢 Bandejão, de segunda a sexta-feira, a partir das 12:30h 🟢

Başak’ın kendisinden sakladığı gerçekler karşısında güveni sarsılan Fatih, boşanmaya karar verir. Bu sırrın Elif üzerinden Ünal köşküne duyurulması aile içi gerilime neden olur.  Lider ise babalık davası açarak Cemo’yu almaya karar verir. Emir ve Ayşin’in nikah alışverişine tanık olan Çimen yaşadığı büyük stresin ardından sürpriz bir test sonucuyla sarsılır. Hesaplaşma günü geldiğinde Lider, Ömer’e silah doğrultur. Tehlikeli yüzleşmenin beklenmedik tanığı ise Kıvılcım olur.

💪 장시간 서서 작업하는 환경에서 잠시 앉아 휴식을 취하거나 반쯤 앉은 자세로 작업해야 하는 상황에서 활용할 수 있으며, 다리 근육에 가해지는 부담을 일부 줄이는 데 도움을 줄 수 있습니다.

🔧 높이 조절이 가능한 지지대와 고정 스트랩을 이용해 사용자의 신체 조건에 맞춰 착용할 수 있으며, 일반적인 접이식 의자와 달리 별도의 보관 공간을 크게 차지하지 않는다는 장점이 있습니다.

🏭 공장 생산라인이나 조립 작업장, 물류창고, 정비 현장 등 장시간 서서 작업하는 장소에서 활용할 수 있으며, 반복적으로 앉았다 일어나는 동작이 필요한 작업 환경에서도 실용적입니다.

🎒 의자 자체를 몸에 착용하는 구조이기 때문에 작업 장소를 옮길 때마다 별도의 의자를 운반할 필요가 없으며, 사용하지 않을 때도 착용 상태로 이동할 수 있도록 설계된 제품입니다.

특히 겉으로 보기에는 다리에 보조 장치를 착용한 모습이지만, 무릎을 굽히고 앉으면 양쪽 지지대가 바닥을 받치면서 의자처럼 사용할 수 있다는 점이 가장 큰 특징입니다.

평소 장시간 서서 일하거나 작업 도중 잠깐씩 앉아서 쉬어야 하는 상황이 많다면, 별도의 의자를 준비하지 않고도 필요한 순간에 앉을 수 있는 색다른 작업 보조용품입니다.

단, 제품의 최대 허용 하중과 신체 사이즈를 확인해야 하며, 지지대가 안정적으로 닿는 평평하고 미끄럽지 않은 바닥에서 사용해야 합니다. 일반적인 의자와 달리 등받이가 없고 착용 상태에서 균형을 유지해야 하므로 낙상에 주의해야 합니다.

snippet.title: العربية وسط تحصينات الحوثي بعد فرار المليشيات
snippet.description:
وثقت كاميرا العربية الأوضاع على الجبهة بين حويشيان ودحيضة في الجوف باليمن، وأظهرت اللقطات الحصرية لقناة العربية تحصينات مليشيات الحوثي التي تركتها عناصر المليشيات وفرت بعد تقدم القوات المسلحة اليمنية ونجاحها في السيطرة على المنطقة.. هذا وتتواصل عمليات "فجر اليمن" التي أطلقت مطلع أكتوبر الماضي على عدة جبهات بين القوات الحكومية ومليشيات الحوثي، مكبدة الحوثيين خسائر عسكرية وبشرية كبيرة. وتستمر العمليات العسكرية وتحتدم المعارك، تحت غطاء من الطيران الحربي، على عدة جبهات بين القوات الحكومية ومليشيات الحوثي. ودخلت عمليات "فجر اليمن"، التي أطلقها رئيس مجلس القيادة الرئاسي اليمني رشاد العليمي في الخامس من أكتوبر، شهرها الثاني، من أجل بسط السيطرة على مؤسسات الدولة وتحرير العاصمة صنعاء من المليشيات الحوثية.
